summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests, Black, or any repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 after ERASE_IN_LINE and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the formatting entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and the Control.title classmethod with a docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning True when the control is buffered and False otherwise, with the requested docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title with the second item. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title (skipped on Windows), and test_control_set_window_title (Windows only, mocked wrapper). Non-legacy paths needed no change because the existing render path already drops control segments when not a terminal. Not verified: tests were not run and Black formatting was not checked.
